$comment: sluice model library — DRAFT manifest (packaging task, 2026-07-21).
Extracts the library out of cli/sluice's hardcoded REGISTRY so it becomes data.
NOT yet wired into the CLI: that is a code change and this task was docs/scripts
only. Wiring it is a separate directive.
RULE: every tok/s here must cite a results/ artifact or a lablog entry. Numbers
with no source do not belong in this file. 'measured_on' names the machine the
number came from, because speed is a function of the machine, not the model.
URLS: every url carries a 'url_checked' stamp written by scripts/check_urls.py
(HEAD only, no download). Re-run it before any release — two stale filenames
have already been found this way (olmoe-7b, then gpt-oss-120b), and a 404 is
invisible until a user tries to pull. 'bytes' is the server's Content-Length,
not a rounded estimate: cli/sluice treats a file below bytes*0.99 as a partial
download, so a rounded-UP size makes a COMPLETE file look truncated forever.
